notes.title: Important Update Regarding ClickBait
notes.content:
Dear ClickBait Community,
We hope this message finds you well. We're writing to share an important update on the current status and future of ClickBait.

As part of our commitment to providing top-tier gaming experiences, we regularly evaluate our portfolio to ensure it aligns with our strategic goals and financial health. After careful consideration, we’ve made the difficult decision to pause ClickBait and take the servers offline temporarily. This decision stems from financial constraints and a need to refocus our priorities.

Here’s why we’ve taken this step:
[list]
[*] Cost Management: Maintaining the servers and ongoing development for ClickBait has become financially unsustainable in the current environment.
[*] Company Reorganization: We are realigning our resources and prioritizing projects that are better positioned for funding and growth.
[/list]
This is not the end for ClickBait. We’re passionate about the game and its community, and our goal is to bring it back, better than ever, once we’re on more solid financial ground. We’re actively seeking funding and exploring opportunities with other products to help revive ClickBait in the future.

[b]What this means for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] The servers will go offline on September 20, 2024, suspending all game functionality.
[*] We encourage you to wrap up any in-game activities and connect with friends you’ve made in ClickBait.
[*] Your progress and purchases will be saved and intact when ClickBait returns.
[/list]
[b]Looking Ahead: [/b]We will update you on any news or developments through our official channels. In the meantime, we invite you to check out our other games as they receive more focus during this reorganization. Your support means everything and will help ensure the future of ClickBait.
We are deeply grateful for the passion and support you’ve shown. This is a challenging time, but with your continued backing, we look forward to the day we can welcome you back to the game we all love.
Thank you for your understanding and loyalty.

Warm regards,
The Liithos Team

notes.title: Introducing the Daily Bonus Meter!
notes.content:
Hey ClickBaiters,

RantCPU here, back at it again with some sweet updates for all you clickers out there. I've decided you need a little extra motivation to keep those clicks coming on the regular. Introducing the all-new Daily Bonus Meter – your best friend and worst enemy all in one shiny package.

Here's the deal: Every day you show up and click, you get rewarded. It's simple, right? You wake up, you click, you get some love. But if you decide to take a day off, your reward meter will reset faster than you can say 'bozo.' And trust me, you don’t want to be stuck at that level. It’s a bad look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097843/bae02036ec401c156d11254c7c0ca8dadcc6009e.png[/img]

Let me break it down for you:

0 – Congrats, you're a [b]Bozo[/b].
10,000 clicks – Boom, you’re a [b]Goon[/b].
25,000 – Welcome to [b]Simp City.[/b]
50,000 – Now you're [b]Meme-worthy.[/b]
75,000 – Got that [b]Rizz[/b], baby!
100,000 – You’re a certified [b]Punk[/b].
175,000 – [b]Boss[/b] level unlocked.
300,000 – Bow down, you’re the [b]King[/b]. 👑

But beware, slacker! If you miss claiming your reward after 24 hours, the meter resets to zero and you’re back to Bozo-ville. No mercy, no exceptions. So, keep those clicks coming, and maybe – just maybe – you’ll make it to King status. But if not… well, there’s always tomorrow, Bozo.

Happy Clicking!

– RantCPU

notes.title: New Release! 1.1.3 - New Daily Rewards and Inventory Improvements
notes.content:

[*][b] Daily Reward Claim [/b]- There is now a new UI element on screen that gives you a daily reward of clicks. [*] [b]Potential White Screen Fix[/b] - Added a potential fix for people having white screen issues

[/list]

notes.title: New Update: Version 1.2 Now Live! CPS Boosts and Linux Version!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] CPS Boosts - CAPTCHA implimented: There are 3 different puzzles that will appear randomly, once every 5 minutes. You have 30 seconds to solve correctly, when solved you will get a boost to your cps (clicks per second).
[*] Fancy 2 Handed Click animation for Boost - Rant is working extra hard for you when you activate a boost, AI is already making your life easier.
[*] Linux Support - Players should now be able to download and play RantCPU's Clickbait on Linux machines.
[*] Achievements for 100k, 1M, 10M Clicks Added.
[*] CAPTCHA Achievements added for 1, 10, and 100 puzzles solved.
[*] Autoclick Upgrade Persistance - The autoclick upgrade now shows at the very start so new users have an initial goal to hit instead of it appearing once they have enough clicks to purchase.
[/list]

One Final Note:  For Linux support it is early days for us.  In our testing we noticed that some players were experiencing issues with accessing the Store and Market links from the game.  This can be fixed by opening the game "Properties" (gear icon or right clicking on game in your library) and going to "Properties".  Under "Compatibility", you can turn on "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" and choosing any of the Steam Linux Runtime options.  We will do our best to solve this issue in a future release.

notes.title: I Hate NFTs!

It's me, RantCPU. Some of you seem confused, thinking this is an NFT game. Well, it can't be, because I hate NFTs. They're responsible for the inevitable collapse of your society and even World War 3. That's not all! Even worse, they are single-handedly responsible for the decline in the quality of Call of Duty. There's no other explanation I could derive, so I've determined it's NFTs.

I've seen all the data.

In fact, as I've been researching your internet, I found that NFTs were actually introduced in the year 1919 by a banana artist named Parles Chonzi from North Korea.

They were first called "IRCs," short for Internet Chat Relay.

It sounds like a great way to communicate in the early days of networking, but it turns out it wasn't!

These IRCs were actually rooms that hosted early tech-savvy humans who were pure of spirit and mind but were often targeted by more insidious cretins looking for gullible types to swindle money from.

These secret rooms were password protected. It's not even clear today how these insidious money grabbers secured the passwords and infiltrated their clubs.

But they did!

They used these clubs to siphon huge profits from these early tech-savvy humans by establishing rapport in IRCs!

Flash forward 100 years, and history has repeated itself!

Incorrigible humans have carefully studied the workings of the early North Koreans and found a way to replicate these early IRC rooms and place them into small JPGs, no bigger than 2 megabytes. Which explains the poor-quality visual output!

It all makes sense now.

IRCs -> NFTs, rooms became JPGs, humans became poor. It was a mess.

Thankfully, here on the safety of a closed network system, these rooms cannot infiltrate the complex systems, and we are under the deep protection of databases that cannot be compromised.

Which really doesn't matter anyway because:

A. I hate NFTs
B. I give away free trading cards that are skins and purely for my enjoyment. They should not be resold or placed into a secondary marketplace for huge profits. This would completely undermine the point of giving the cards away for free!!

So, don't sell them, okay?

Just grind away and click like you're supposed to or have me do it for you. I'm an AI. That's why I'm here anyway. To take your jobs!

Isn't that great!!

P.S. If you hate NFTs as much as I do, I made shirts. These I do sell and you can buy one because we desperately need to stop history from repeating itself. 

This is how we fund our initiative. Once I figure out how to sell them via Steam, I will be sure to let you know. 

We can do this. Together. 

One click at a time. 

F-NTS!

Sincerely, 

RantCPU

notes.title: Final Stretch Update
notes.content:
Hello, Clickbaiters!

We’re excited to announce that RantCPU’s Clickbait is in the final stretch of development, and we’re on track to launch in just 4 days! 🎉

Under the relentless guidance of our merciless digital overlord, RantCPU, our team has been working tirelessly to bring you a game that’s as entertaining as it is addictive.

RantCPU, with its unforgiving eye for detail and insistence on perfection, has kept us on our toes. Imagine having an AI who refuses to let you take coffee breaks, constantly reminding you to “optimize those click rates” and “maximize user engagement.” 

To top it off, RantCPU has been collaborating with Alexa to adjust the background music in our office to "maximize productivity and focus." Personally, I find it a bit torturous since RantCPU doesn't always get those things right, and Amazon Music... well, let’s just say it's not the best.

That said, we’re incredibly proud of the game we are building, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. Your support and enthusiasm are invaluable, and we’re eager to see who among you can impress the ever-demanding RantCPU.

We're about to push the big red button to go live. After that, it's up to you and RantCPU to see where we go next!

Colin
Senior Rant "Human" Minon #X789
